dz: 查科战争期间巴拉圭和玻利维亚之间的博克龙战役的最后一天.
de: Last day of the Battle of Boquerón between Paraguay and Bolivia during the Chaco War.

t: 伊拉克王国从联合王国获得独立.
te: The Kingdom of Iraq gains independence from the United Kingdom.
dz: 伊拉克王国从联合王国获得独立.
de: The Kingdom of Iraq gains independence from the United Kingdom.

t: 塔塔航空公司（后来成为印度航空公司）首次飞行。
te: Tata Airlines (later to become Air India) makes its first flight.
dz: 塔塔航空公司（后来成为印度航空公司）首次飞行。
de: Tata Airlines (later to become Air India) makes its first flight.

t: 乔治·兰斯伯里成为了反对党英国工党的领导人.
te: George Lansbury became the leader of the opposition British Labour Party.
dz: 乔治·兰斯伯里成为了反对党英国工党的领导人.
de: George Lansbury became the leader of the opposition British Labour Party.

t: 帕纳吉斯·察尔达里斯出任希腊第142任总理.
te: Panagis Tsaldaris becomes the 142nd Prime Minister of Greece.
dz: 帕纳吉斯·察尔达里斯出任希腊第142任总理.
de: Panagis Tsaldaris becomes the 142nd Prime Minister of Greece.

t: 富兰克林·D·罗斯福被选为第32任美国总统,击败了现任总统赫伯特·胡佛.
te: Franklin D. Roosevelt is elected as the 32nd President of the United States, defeating incumbent president Herbert Hoov…
dz: 富兰克林·D·罗斯福被选为第32任美国总统,击败了现任总统赫伯特·胡佛.
de: Franklin D. Roosevelt is elected as the 32nd President of the United States, defeating incumbent president Herbert Hoover.

t: 在华盛顿特区，FBI 科学犯罪侦查实验室（更广为人知的名称是 FBI 犯罪实验室）正式开业。
te: In Washington, D.C., the FBI Scientific Crime Detection Laboratory (better known as the FBI Crime Lab) officially opens.
dz: 在华盛顿特区，FBI 科学犯罪侦查实验室（更广为人知的名称是 FBI 犯罪实验室）正式开业。
de: In Washington, D.C., the FBI Scientific Crime Detection Laboratory (better known as the FBI Crime Lab) officially opens.

t: 德国出生的瑞士物理学家阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦获得美国签证.
te: German-born Swiss physicist Albert Einstein is granted an American visa.
dz: 德国出生的瑞士物理学家阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦获得美国签证.
de: German-born Swiss physicist Albert Einstein is granted an American visa.

t: 泰国成为君主立宪制国家。
te: Thailand becomes a constitutional monarchy.
dz: 泰国成为君主立宪制国家。
de: Thailand becomes a constitutional monarchy.

t: 芝加哥熊队在首场NFL季后赛中击败了波特斯茅斯斯斯巴达人,赢得了NFL冠军.
te: The Chicago Bears defeat the Portsmouth Spartans in the first NFL playoff game to win the NFL Championship.
dz: 芝加哥熊队在首场NFL季后赛中击败了波特斯茅斯斯斯巴达人,赢得了NFL冠军.
de: The Chicago Bears defeat the Portsmouth Spartans in the first NFL playoff game to win the NFL Championship.

t: BBC World Service 开始作为 BBC Empire Service 进行广播。
te: BBC World Service begins broadcasting as the BBC Empire Service.
dz: BBC World Service 开始作为 BBC Empire Service 进行广播。
de: BBC World Service begins broadcasting as the BBC Empire Service.

t: 中国甘肃发生7.6级地震,死亡275人.
te: A magnitude 7.6 earthquake in Gansu, China kills 275 people.
dz: 中国甘肃发生7.6级地震,死亡275人.
de: A magnitude 7.6 earthquake in Gansu, China kills 275 people.

t: 电台城市音乐会馆"国家之所"在纽约市开通.
te: Radio City Music Hall, "Showplace of the Nation", opens in New York City.
dz: 电台城市音乐会馆"国家之所"在纽约市开通.
de: Radio City Music Hall, "Showplace of the Nation", opens in New York City.
